outputs.explanation: Deconvoluted mass spectrum (line/intensity trace) from a single native MS acquisition; this is a spectral trace, not an averaged summary statistic, so individual data points do not apply (analogous to a line plot).
Same as A: a single deconvoluted mass spectrum trace, not an average requiring individual point overlay.

Bar chart shows the proportion of protein bound to specific numbers of metal atoms as measured directly from a single native MS spectrum's peak intensities; there are no error bars and no indication these bars represent an average across replicate measurements, so there are no underlying individual data points to overlay.
Same type of native-MS-derived fraction bar chart as C, representing a single-spectrum quantification rather than an average of replicates; no error bars are shown.
Same type of native-MS-derived fraction bar chart as C/D; single-measurement proportions, not averages needing individual point display.
Same type of native-MS-derived fraction bar chart as C/D/E; single-measurement proportions, not averages needing individual point display.

Bar-per-residue plot of chemical shift perturbation (CSP) values at three different metal equivalents; each bar is a single measured CSP value (no error bars), not a mean across replicates, so individual points do not apply.
Same as G: per-residue CSP bar plot for cadmium titration, single measured values rather than averaged data requiring individual point overlay.
